description: This file defines an API service interface 'ApiService' used for communication with the backend of a garment retail platform. It contains method signatures for fetching products, user login, registration, and checkout, serving as a stub/mock implementation to be replaced by real HTTP calls.

classes.name: ApiService
classes.description: Interface defining methods for interacting with the garment store backend, including product retrieval, user login/registration, and checkout.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Fetches a list of products, optionally filtered by a query string.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Attempts user login with provided email and password, returns a UserSession.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a new user with name, email, and password, returning a UserSession.

methods.name: checkout
methods.description: Places an order with a token and cart details, returning an OrderSummary.
